section_summary.extract_value: Table 1 presents descriptive statistics (means, standard deviations, Cronbach alphas) and intercorrelation scores for self-report measures collected from 490 participants. The table includes measures of age, BMI, Early Memories of Warmth and Safeness Scale (EMWSS), Self-Compassion (SC), Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2), and various subscales of the Eating Disorder Examination Questionnaire (EDE-Q). The correlation between BAS-2 and BMI is -.37 (p < .001), indicating a significant negative relationship.

section_summary.extract_value: Figure 1 presents a final path model showing relationships between Early Memories of Warmth and Safeness Scale (EMWSS), Self-Compassion, BMI, Age, Body Appreciation (measured with BAS-2), and Eating Disorder Examination Questionnaire (EDE-Q). The model shows a direct negative path from BMI to Body Appreciation (-.34***) and indicates that Body Appreciation negatively predicts EDE-Q (-.59***). The figure includes error terms (E1, E2, E3) and R² values for endogenous variables.
